sentence: This project combines artificial intelligence with a DNA-encoded library to look for drugs that act on several targets in substance use disorders.
This project studies how alternative splicing works and is controlled during a developmental process that is abnormally active in tissue fibrosis and cancer metastasis.
This project develops a nanovaccine against pancreatic cancer that targets tumor heterogeneity to make immunotherapy work better.
This project builds a nanoliter screening technology that makes directed evolution of biocatalysts more efficient.
This project builds a hair cell model from the stinging cells of cnidarians to study the mechanisms of mechanotransduction in hair cells.
This project studies how progenitor cells that make blood cells are controlled by immune cells and how they support hematopoiesis over time.
This project builds software that combines artificial intelligence with Monte Carlo simulation to improve the accuracy of single photon emission tomography scans.
This project builds computer maps and models of cancer cells to predict how tumors respond to drugs.
This project studies how balancing two transcription factors in T cells can reduce T cell exhaustion.
This project studies how oxytocin affects glucose sensing in the hypothalamus and how social isolation relates to diabetes and dementia.
This project tests whether editing the Apolipoprotein E gene from the E4 version to a less risky version protects mice against Alzheimer's disease.
This project designs and tests ways to improve hematopoietic cell transplantation for hematological malignancies and other diseases.
This project measures brain activity directly during standing balance tasks to understand how older adults and people after stroke control balance.
This project shares tools for in vivo microendoscopy imaging, including open source software, with outside researchers.
This project develops tests to find aggressive prostate cancer early while avoiding unnecessary testing and overtreatment.
This project studies how neonatal tissue damage changes synapses in spinal pain circuits and relates to chronic pain in adulthood.
This project studies how often a pre-leukemic clone appears at birth, how long it persists and how it relates to childhood leukemia.
This project studies behavioral weight loss interventions to improve outcomes of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease among Mexican and Central American patients.
